scene.topic_description:
Situation: You are in the main job interview on Friday with the person hiring for the role. Your main worry is answering simple questions about your past experience clearly enough to make a good impression and understand what the job includes.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: checking in at reception, waiting arrangements, handing over documents at the front desk.
must_say: say where you worked before — slot: the workplace
say what your job was — slot: the job title
say how long you worked there — slot: the length of time
explain what your main duties were — slot: the duty
answer whether you have used a tool or skill — slot: the tool or skill
ask what the main duties are — slot: the position
ask whether training is provided — slot: the skill or task
ask what the next step is — slot: none
must_understand: asks where you worked before and for how long
asks what your main duties were
asks whether you have used a tool or skill before
says what the job involves day to day
explains the next step in the hiring process

findings.detail: the right option «Every day» repeats «every day» of A's «Customer contact and administrative tasks, every day.»
the right option «La început» repeats «la început» of A's «Da, oferim instruire la început.»
the right option «Un răspuns prin e-mail până luni» repeats «un răspuns» of A's «Următorul pas este un răspuns prin e-mail până luni.»
the right option «Contact cu clienții și sarcini de birou zilnic» repeats «cu clienții» of A's «Postul include lucru cu clienții și sarcini administrative în fiecare zi.»
the right option «În fiecare zi» repeats «în fiecare» of A's «Lucru cu clienții și sarcini administrative, în fiecare zi.»
the right option «La început» repeats «la început» of A's «Da, oferim instruire la început.»
the right option «Un răspuns prin e-mail până luni» repeats «un răspuns» of A's «Următorul pas este un răspuns prin e-mail până luni.»

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Where did you work before?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: I worked at a shop.

messages.text_native: How long did you work there?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: I worked for two years.

check.text_native: What does the interviewer want to find out?
check.explanation_native: The interviewer wants to know the duration of your work there.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: What were your main duties?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: I was responsible for customers.

check.text_target: Ce vrea să știe intervievatorul exact?

options.text_native: The place of the last job

check.explanation_native: The interviewer is asking about your main responsibilities.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Have you used this software before?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: Yes, I have used Excel.

options.text_native: Whether you have experience with the software

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Care sunt sarcinile pentru acest post?
messages.text_native: What are the main duties for this position?
messages.pronunciation_native: KAH-reh soont sar-CHEE-neh-leh pen-troo AH-chest post

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Postul include lucru cu clienții și sarcini administrative în fiecare zi.
messages.text_native: The job includes customer contact and administrative tasks every day.

options.text_target: Relații cu publicul și activități de birou zilnice
options.text_native: Public interaction and daily office duties

check.explanation_native: The interviewer says the job involves public interaction and daily administrative duties.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: Could you repeat, please?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Lucru cu clienții și sarcini administrative, în fiecare zi.
messages.text_native: Customer contact and administrative tasks, every day.

check.text_target: Cât de des sunt aceste sarcini?
check.explanation_native: The interviewer says these tasks occur day after day.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: Do you provide training for the internal system?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Yes, we provide training at the beginning.

check.explanation_native: The interviewer says the training is provided at the beginning.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: What is the next step?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Următorul pas este un răspuns prin e-mail până luni.
messages.text_native: The next step is a reply by email by Monday.

messages.text_native: What position did you have before?
